The *Āsavasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 8.16) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka. Like other sections of the *Duka-paṭṭhāna*, it applies the twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) to the dyad (*duka*) of states associated with defilements or influxes (*āsava-sampayutta*). No direct discussions of this individual section were retrieved in the examined secondary passages, which instead treat the corresponding dyadic definitions found in the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī*.
